relations: Five fixed spheres maintain positions while surrounding dye fields slowly diffuse and blur color boundaries.
Deep-red halo around the rightmost sphere spreads outward as that sphere lightens toward pinkish speckled tones.
Green S-shaped band softens as adjacent yellow and orange fields bleed into it.
Pale surface border and camera remain still while diffusion proceeds.
caption: The video showcases a top-down view of five spheres in a horizontal row on a pale surface, each ringed by colored dye. From left to right the spheres read amber-orange, pale yellow-green, yellow, orange, and dark maroon, each with a central mark. A yellow field fills the left, a green S-shaped band weaves between the second and third spheres, and an orange-to-deep-red field occupies the right, with a dark maroon halo around the fifth sphere. The spheres stay fixed while the surrounding liquid slowly diffuses, its color boundaries softening and blurring. The deep-red halo around the rightmost sphere spreads outward as the sphere itself lightens, becoming pinkish and speckled. The green band softens subtly as the yellow and orange fields bleed further, the camera and white border remaining still.
